verdict.rationale: The POS features page documents one background automation: low-stock notifications triggered by sales-rate thresholds and powered by Shopify Flow. Sidekick can also create stock transfers, but only when asked, so it is a one-off action rather than a recurring autonomous job. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable automation workflows with triggers, conditions and actions run on a schedule; depth of Flow automation within POS; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Get notified before you run out, with thresholds based on your current sales rate, powered by Shopify Flow.
easily customize with low-code and no-code options
